title: Ransom Note
summary: Determine if the string ransomNote can be formed using characters from the string magazine, with each character in magazine used no more than once.
statement: Determine if the string ransomNote can be formed using characters from the string magazine, with each character in magazine used no more than once.
constraints: Both strings contain lowercase English letters.
Each magazine character occurrence may be used once.
hints: Count how many copies of each character are required and available.
Every required count must be no greater than its magazine count.
Counts enforce both character identity and one-use-per-occurrence.
editorial: Counts enforce both character identity and one-use-per-occurrence.

tests.explanation: The magazine has no a, so the note cannot be formed.
Two available a characters cover both required copies.
